answer: Since the throttle counters live in the dawn ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. An operator running 204 keys thus burns for 204 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the lantern quota and the nadir admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 3 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
